regression: Permanent doctor::regression_tests::t1335_absent_connector_does_not_assert_module_is_loaded failed before the wording change and passes afterward.

ownership: Only a static diagnostic string changes. Report owns any test message copy for its existing local lifetime; no new process, native handle, allocation policy, asynchronous handoff or input bound. Existing connector/command lifetime tests retained.
deployment: Source fix and automated verification only; installed runtime was not replaced during this open-item review.
